description: ETF rotation strategy with systematic withdrawal feature during churning phase

notes.accumulation_phase: During accumulation, the strategy buys ETFs worth 'accumulation_per_week' amount every week
notes.churning_phase: During churning, the strategy sells ETFs worth 'accumulation_per_week + withdraw_amount' every week
notes.withdrawal_logic: The 'withdraw_amount' represents weekly withdrawals from the portfolio
notes.total_withdrawn: The strategy tracks and reports the total amount withdrawn during the entire backtest period
